about: BLS Polymers Limited manufactures multiple grades of custom-formulated polymer compounds used in wires and cables as well as industrial pipe coatings. The company serves critical infrastructure industries including telecommunications, power, railways, water supply, and oil and gas distribution. It operates from a single manufacturing facility located in Goa with an installed capacity of 35,251 MTPA as of Fiscal 2026.

objects.purpose: Financing capital expenditure requirement towards expansion of Goa Manufacturing Facility
Funding working capital requirements of our Company

promoters.background: Promoters possess decades of experience in the polymer industry and represent the BLS Group, which has listed entities BLS International Services and BLS E-Services.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers contributed 66.81% and top 5 customers accounted for 53.45% of revenue in FY26. Government sales contributed 0.30% in FY26.

litigation_note: Contingent liabilities of ₹9.72 crore as of FY26 include ₹8.00 crore IOCL bank guarantee, ₹54.83 lakhs GST appeals, and ₹23.35 lakhs disputed income tax.
strengths: Pre-approved product enlistments with CPSEs (Maharatna, Navratna, Miniratna) and state agencies act as high barriers to entry.
Diversified portfolio offering 6 products across 127 grades for power, telecommunications, railways, and pipeline coating sectors.
Established track record with 90.84% repeat customer orders over the last three fiscal years.
Pan-India distribution across 23 states and union territories, alongside export footprints across the Middle East.
In-house product development and testing capabilities with ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturing infrastructure.
Strong parentage of the BLS Group offering brand equity and cross-industry leadership support.
Robust financial growth with PAT growing from ₹7.52 crore in FY24 to ₹27.01 crore in FY26.

risks.title: High Customer Concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers accounted for 66.81%, 64.44% and 50.52% of revenues in Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024; loss of any key client could impact operations.

risks.title: Product Segment Concentration
risks.detail: Wire and cable polymer compounds contributed 80.93%, 81.59% and 80.49% of revenues in Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024, leaving the company sensitive to sector downturns.

risks.title: Single Manufacturing Facility Risk
risks.detail: All manufacturing is conducted at a single facility in Goa, leaving business vulnerable to local disruptions, natural disasters, or operational shutdowns.

risks.title: Related Party Dealings with Group Entity
risks.detail: Purchased raw materials worth ₹32.35 crore (9.26% of revenue) in FY26 from group company Vinsul Makardi Limited, which operates in a competing line of business.

risks.title: Capacity Expansion Execution and Delay Risks
risks.detail: Capex plan of ₹77.56 crore to expand Goa capacity by 52,050 MTPA faces risks of cost overruns and delays in ordering plant and machinery.

risks.title: Substantial Indebtedness and Working Capital Intensity
risks.detail: Total fund-based indebtedness stood at ₹82.36 crore as of August 31, 2026, with substantial working capital locked in receivables and inventory.

risks.title: Past Negative Operating Cash Flow
risks.detail: Reported negative cash flow from operating activities of ₹6.64 crore for the three months ended June 30, 2026.

risks.title: Corporate Record Gaps and Untraceable Shareholders
risks.detail: Certain past filings, secretarial records, and charge registrations are untraceable or non-compliant, alongside 46 untraceable shareholders holding 3,32,851 equity shares.

notes: Financial figures for FY24, FY25, and FY26 are derived from restated financial statements. Three-month stub period ended June 30, 2026 (Revenue: ₹107.03 cr, PAT: ₹10.23 cr) is excluded from annual arrays.
